source: BBOC 2025 Mountain West & Pac-2 Betting Preview Part 1 (Mike Calabrese/Stuckey/Collin Wilson/Josh 'Duck' Nunn)

teams.key_avoids: PLAYS WASHINGTON STATE TWICE (correlated win totals — both times OSU is off a bye, an edge). Faces the 3rd-fewest returning starters in the country (8 new-QB opponents) — lots of variance. Losses to Texas Tech + Oregon baked in; could start 0-4/1-4 (at Houston off their bye is a bad spot). Hedge games late: both WSU games + Wake Forest.
teams.bboc_notes: All lean UNDER after the line moved (opened 6.5, Colin under 6.5 +150 at a 6.0 projection; Stuckey projected 6.8 but the market pushed to ~7.2; Duck has trench concerns). RB Anthony Hankerson is a stud (57 missed tackles forced). QB Malik Murphy (Duke) has a cannon but is inaccurate and his TWP rate skyrockets under pressure — behind an OL returning just 44 starts (97th) that lost its LT/RT/LG to the NFL. New OC Ryan Gunderson (unlocked DTR at UCLA) is a plus. Trent Bray takes back defensive play-calling to restore havoc (they had a nation-worst 7 sacks last year, top-100+ in havoc) — but the DL is light/inexperienced and may not stop the run. Injuries decimated them in 2024 (17 of 22 on the two-deep hurt at once). Who throws on them? Nobody — but the trenches are the whole risk. Lean under.

teams.qb_status: Battle — Zevi Eckhaus / dugger (Pitt) / Shepard (Rutgers) / Potter
teams.key_avoids: PLAYS OREGON STATE TWICE (correlated totals; both times OSU is off a bye — disadvantage). Four trips east of the Mountain time zone (unusual): North Texas, Colorado State, at Ole Miss then double-back at Virginia, at JMU. Three sure wins: Idaho, San Diego State, La Tech (La Tech on back-to-back travel).
teams.bboc_notes: HOST SPLIT — Stuckey + Duck UNDER 5.5 (project ~4.58 / 4.8, depth is the worry), while Colin is the CONTRARIAN over-lean (projects 5.8, +130 says over but he's waiting for a better number ~Aug 19). New HC Jimmy Rogers (27-3 at South Dakota State) brings ground-and-pound + his whole SDSU staff and ~27 FCS transfers (74 new players total, ~8 potential D starters from SDSU) — essentially 'SDSU reincarnate,' a real drop in Pac-12-caliber athletes stepping up in class. 134th in returning production (Stuckey went 9-5-1 on those bottom-15 unders last year). QB battle (Zevi Eckhaus mobile, 1,000 rush yds at Bryant, fits the run scheme); DC Jesse Bobbitt ran SDSU's #1-FCS-scoring D but the DL depth/size is the big worry. Tricky schedule; under lean.
